name: BINANCE_SYMBOLS
description: Comma-separated list of trading symbols to monitor and score
suggested_range: Any valid Binance symbol pairs, comma-separated

name: HTTP_POOL_SIZE
description: Total maximum connections in the aiohttp TCP connection pool

name: HTTP_CONNECT_LIMIT
description: Maximum connections per host in the aiohttp TCP pool

name: HTTP_TIMEOUT_TOTAL
description: Total HTTP request timeout in seconds for aiohttp session

name: FUTURES_ENABLED
description: Enable/disable fetching of Binance Futures metrics (OI, funding rate, mark price)

name: FUTURES_CACHE_TTL
description: Cache TTL in seconds for Binance Futures metrics (OI, funding, mark price)

name: FUTURES_BASE
description: Base URL for Binance Futures REST API endpoints

name: GOLD_REAL_ENABLED
description: Enable real XAU/USD data (via Twelve Data or Yahoo Finance) instead of PAXG/USDT proxy

name: GOLD_CACHE_TTL
description: Cache TTL in seconds for XAU/USD Gold candle data

name: DELTA_VOL_ENABLED
description: Enable delta volume calculation from aggTrade WebSocket stream (buy/sell pressure)

name: DELTA_VOL_WINDOW
description: Rolling window size (number of trades) for delta volume calculation

name: DELTA_VOL_SIGNAL_PCT
description: Minimum fraction of buy volume (or sell volume) to qualify directional pressure as a strong signal. 0.60 = 60% buy or sell.

name: USE_1D_BIAS
description: Enable the EMA200 daily macro bias criterion in the 11-point score

name: D1_CACHE_TTL
description: Cache TTL in seconds for daily (1D) klines (candles change infrequently)

name: D1_LIMIT
description: Number of daily historical candles to fetch (approx 1 year of history for EMA200 warmup)

name: MAX_1S
description: Maximum number of 1-second OHLCV ticks to keep in raw_1s buffer (1800 = 30 minutes at 1s resolution)

name: MAX_CANDLES_30S
description: Maximum number of 30-second OHLCV candles retained in candle_store per symbol (~4h10 history)

name: SCAN_INTERVAL
description: Interval in seconds between full signal scoring cycles across all symbols

name: ACTIVE_TF
description: Active timeframe displayed on dashboard; governs OB/FVG lookbacks and confirmation timeframe in score_setup(). Valid values: 1m|3m|5m|15m|30m|1h|4h

name: MIN_DF30_FOR_SCAN
description: Minimum number of 30-second candles required before triggering a scan (warmup guard)

name: OB_FVG_ATR_MULT
description: [V9-5] ATR multiplier for OB/FVG proximity tolerance when Fibonacci dynamic mode is disabled or used as fallback. Mid-point of OTE Fibonacci zone [0.618-0.786].

name: OB_FVG_PCT_FALLBACK
description: Percentage of price used as absolute fallback tolerance for OB/FVG proximity when ATR is unavailable (0.4% of price)

name: OB_FVG_FIB_DYNAMIC
description: Enable dynamic Fibonacci [0.618-0.786] tolerance for OB/FVG alignment. When false, reverts to fixed ATR x OB_FVG_ATR_MULT tolerance.

name: FIB_LEVEL_LOW
description: Lower Fibonacci retracement level defining the OTE (Optimal Trade Entry) zone lower bound

name: FIB_LEVEL_HIGH
description: Upper Fibonacci retracement level defining the OTE zone upper bound

name: FIB_SWING_LOOKBACK
description: Number of candles to look back when detecting swing high/low for Fibonacci tolerance calculation

name: RSI_ENTRY_LONG
description: [V9-1] RSI oversold threshold for LONG entry qualification. Signal accepted if RSI(5m) <= this value. Tighter than classic 30 to filter weak reversals.

name: RSI_ENTRY_SHORT
description: [V9-1] RSI overbought threshold for SHORT entry qualification. Signal accepted if RSI(5m) >= this value. Tighter than classic 70.

name: RSI_TF_PRIMARY
description: Primary timeframe used for RSI fallback calculation when TRIX STRICT signal is not available

name: RSI_CONFIRM_5M
description: Enable double RSI confirmation using 5m + 10m (resampled) timeframes for the fallback RSI signal

name: PAXG_ATR_MULT
location: env var via os.getenv('PAXG_ATR_MULT', '1.2') inside SYM_OVERRIDES['PAXG/USDT']
description: ATR multiplier for SL calculation specifically for PAXG/Gold. Slightly tighter than backtest best (1.3) to produce tighter stops.

name: PAXG_TP_RATIOS
location: env var via os.getenv('PAXG_TP_RATIOS', '1.0,1.5,2.0') inside SYM_OVERRIDES['PAXG/USDT']
description: Risk:Reward ratios for TP1/TP2/TP3 for PAXG/Gold. Calibrated for Gold's mean-reverting behavior (shorter TPs than crypto).

name: PAXG_RSI_LONG
location: env var via os.getenv('PAXG_RSI_LONG', '35') inside SYM_OVERRIDES['PAXG/USDT']
description: RSI oversold threshold for PAXG/Gold LONG entries. Higher than crypto (35 vs 28) because Gold reverses at less extreme RSI levels.

name: PAXG_RSI_SHORT
location: env var via os.getenv('PAXG_RSI_SHORT', '65') inside SYM_OVERRIDES['PAXG/USDT']
description: RSI overbought threshold for PAXG/Gold SHORT entries. Lower than crypto (65 vs 72) because Gold reverses earlier.

name: PAXG_SCORE_MIN
location: env var via os.getenv('PAXG_SCORE_MIN', '5') inside SYM_OVERRIDES['PAXG/USDT']
description: Minimum score (out of 11) required to emit a signal for PAXG/Gold. Lower than global minimum (5 vs 7) due to Gold's lower confluence rate.

name: PAXG_SL_FLOOR_PCT
location: env var via os.getenv('PAXG_SL_FLOOR_PCT', '0.0025') inside SYM_OVERRIDES['PAXG/USDT']
description: Minimum SL distance as a fraction of entry price for PAXG/Gold (prevents micro stops on high-priced Gold). E.g. 4985 x 0.0025 = $12.5 minimum SL.

name: OPT_YEAR
description: Calendar year used to filter candles for the annual SL/TP optimization backtest (Module 18). Set to 0 to use all available data.

name: OPT_REFRESH_HOURS
description: How often (in hours) the annual optimization loop re-runs automatically

name: OPT_MIN_CANDLES
description: Minimum number of candles required to run the optimization backtest for a symbol

name: OPT_FEE_BPS
description: Trading fee in basis points (bps) applied during optimization backtests. 4 bps = 0.04% (standard Binance maker/taker).

name: OPT_SCORE_CRITERIA
description: Objective function for selecting the best SL/TP config. 'sharpe' = Sharpe ratio only; 'expectancy' = expected value per trade; 'combined' = 0.5xSharpe + 0.3xExpectancy + 0.2x(1-|MaxDD|).

name: OPT_TF
description: Timeframe used when fetching historical data for the optimization backtest

name: OPT_IN_SAMPLE_DAYS
description: Number of days of history fetched for the optimization in-sample backtest (60 days = ~17280 5m candles)

name: ENABLE_BRIDGE
description: Enable the /api/push bridge endpoint for receiving external signals (disabled by default in standalone mode)

name: TELEGRAM_MIN_INTERVAL_SEC
description: Minimum interval in seconds between Telegram alerts per symbol (anti-spam throttle)

name: TELEGRAM_SCORE_THRESHOLD
description: Minimum score (out of 11) required to trigger a Telegram alert

name: WS_COMPRESS
description: WebSocket compression mode. 'off' = raw JSON text; 'gzip_base64' = gzip-compressed base64-encoded envelope for large payloads

name: WS_COMPRESS_MIN_BYTES
description: Minimum payload size in bytes before WebSocket gzip compression is applied

name: H4_CACHE_TTL
description: Cache TTL in seconds for 4H and 2H klines (also used for H2 in _CACHE_REGISTRY)

name: M1_CACHE_TTL
description: Cache TTL in seconds for 1m klines

name: M1_LIMIT
location: env var via os.getenv('M1_LIMIT', '260') — actual effective value is 500 in _CACHE_REGISTRY
description: Number of 1m candles to fetch from Binance REST

name: H4_LIMIT
location: env var via os.getenv('H4_LIMIT', '210') — actual effective value is 500 in _CACHE_REGISTRY (hardcoded override)
description: Number of 4H candles to fetch from Binance REST (~83 days of history for EMA200 warmup)

name: STRICT_TF
description: Timeframe used for the STRICT TRIX indicator calibration and walk-forward backtest

name: STRICT_RECALIB_DAYS
description: Interval in days between automatic STRICT TRIX recalibrations (walk-forward re-optimization). Was 90 in v8.

name: STRICT_IN_SAMPLE_DAYS
description: Number of days of historical data used for STRICT TRIX in-sample optimization. 120d ~= 34k 5m candles. Was 180 in v8.

name: STRICT_MAX_BARS
location: env var via os.getenv('STRICT_MAX_BARS') or derived automatically if not set
description: Hard cap on number of 5m bars used for STRICT optimization to limit CPU use. Derived from STRICT_IN_SAMPLE_DAYS if not explicitly set.

name: STRICT_RANDOM_ITERS
description: Number of random search iterations for STRICT TRIX parameter optimization. 300 is intermediate (400 too slow, 200 too few). Was 400 in v8.

name: STRICT_FEE_BPS
description: Approximate trading fee in basis points used during STRICT TRIX Sharpe calibration

name: STRICT_MIN_TRADES
description: Minimum number of trades per sub-period required for a Sharpe to be counted in the robust score. Prevents phantom Sharpe from very low activity.

name: STRICT_SHARPE_FLOOR
description: [V9-6] Minimum Sharpe per sub-period for a configuration to be considered valid in robust scoring. 0.30 (vs 0.20 in v8) = more discriminating filter.

name: STRICT_SUBPERIOD_DAYS
description: Length in days of each sub-period used in the walk-forward robustness test for STRICT TRIX

name: STRICT_ROBUST_MIN_PERIODS
description: Minimum number of sub-periods where Sharpe must exceed STRICT_SHARPE_FLOOR for a configuration to be considered robust

name: STRICT_TOPK_ZONES
description: Number of top scoring parameter zones to extract from the Gaussian-blurred TRIX heatmap

name: STRICT_ZONE_MIN_DIST
description: Minimum distance (in parameter grid cells) between selected top-k zones to ensure parameter diversity

name: STRICT_OFFLOAD_PROCESS
description: Enable STRICT recalibration in a separate subprocess (mode-pro). Disabled by default on Windows due to SSL/aiohttp spawn issues. Enable on Linux/Mac for best performance.

name: STRICT_WORKERS
description: Number of parallel worker processes for STRICT recalibration (only used when STRICT_OFFLOAD_PROCESS=1)

name: STRICT_JOB_QUEUE_MAX
description: Maximum capacity of the STRICT job queue used in subprocess mode

name: LIQUIDITY_LOOKBACK
description: [V9-3] Historical lookback window (candles) for detecting Liquidity Sweeps/Stop Hunts. Higher = larger historical context. Was 40 in v8.

name: ADX_TREND_THRESHOLD
description: [V9-2] ADX14 threshold separating TREND from RANGE regime. Above: continuation FVG favored (+1 pt); below: OB rebound favored (+1 pt). Was 25.0 in v8.

name: MAX_DD_MULTIPLIER
description: [V9-4] Circuit breaker drawdown multiplier. If live drawdown > backtest_max_DD x this value, forces re-optimization. 1.3 = 30% overshoot allowed. Was 1.5 in v8.

name: SCORE_MIN_REQUIRED
description: Global minimum score out of 11 required to emit a WebSocket signal and record it in history. Recommended 7/11 to filter weak setups.

name: CB_CHECK_INTERVAL
description: Frequency in seconds of the circuit breaker drawdown monitor check loop (default 1 hour)

name: M5_CACHE_TTL
description: Cache TTL in seconds for 5m klines used by STRICT indicator and signal scoring

name: M5_LIMIT
location: env var via os.getenv('M5_LIMIT', '600') — effective value in _CACHE_REGISTRY is 1000
description: Number of 5m candles to fetch from Binance REST (~3.5 days of history)

name: CANDLE_PERSIST
description: Enable periodic persistence of candle_store to disk (JSON) for recovery after restart

name: CANDLE_PERSIST_EVERY_SEC
description: Interval in seconds between candle_store persistence writes to disk (5 min default)

name: SIGNAL_HISTORY_FILE
description: Path to the JSON file where signal outcomes are persisted for adaptive learning

name: SCORING_WEIGHTS_FILE
description: Path to the JSON file where per-symbol adaptive scoring weights are persisted

name: LEARNING_REPORT_EVERY
description: Interval in seconds between adaptive learning report generation cycles (default 2 hours = 7200s)

name: LEARNING_MIN_SIGNALS
description: Minimum number of closed signals required before adaptive weight adjustment is computed and suggested

name: LEARNING_ADAPT_RATE
description: Rate at which per-criterion weights are adjusted per learning cycle. Formula: new_w = clip(current_w + rate x delta x 10, 0.5, 2.0). Low = conservative, slow adaptation.

name: SCORING_WEIGHTS_INITIAL
location: hardcoded in scoring_weights dict initialization: {c: 1.0 for c in SCORE_CRITERIA}
description: Initial weight assigned to every scoring criterion before adaptive learning adjusts them. Adaptive range is clamped to [0.5, 2.0].

name: SCORING_WEIGHT_MIN
description: Minimum clamp value for any adaptive scoring weight. Prevents a criterion from being completely ignored.

name: SCORING_WEIGHT_MAX
description: Maximum clamp value for any adaptive scoring weight. Prevents a single criterion from dominating.

name: STRICT_JOB_TIMEOUT_MIN
description: Watchdog timeout in minutes for STRICT calibration jobs. Jobs exceeding this are forcibly reset. (300 iters expected ~8-12 min).

name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
description: Base URL of the local Ollama server for Vision AI analysis
suggested_range: Any valid URL with Ollama running

name: VISION_MODEL_PRIMARY
description: Primary Ollama model for Vision AI chart analysis. Qwen2.5-VL 3B Q4 is faster and more accurate than LLaVA on CPU.

name: VISION_MODEL_FALLBACK
description: Fallback Ollama model if the primary vision model fails

name: VISION_NUM_CTX
description: Context window size (tokens) passed to Ollama vision model. Larger = more context but slower and more VRAM/RAM.

name: VISION_KEEP_ALIVE
description: Duration to keep the Ollama vision model loaded in memory after the last request (Ollama keep_alive parameter)

name: VISION_TIMEOUT_PRIMARY
description: HTTP timeout in seconds for the primary vision model request (7 min, increased from 3 min due to CPU-bound LLaVA latency)

name: VISION_TIMEOUT_FALLBACK
description: HTTP timeout in seconds for the fallback vision model request (2 min)

name: VISION_TEXT_ONLY
description: When true, never sends the chart image to Ollama; analysis is based solely on algorithmic context (faster, useful when vision models time out)

name: VISION_CACHE_TTL
description: Cache TTL in seconds for Ollama vision analysis results (keyed by image hash + symbol + timeframe)

name: VISION_CACHE_SIZE
description: Maximum number of vision analysis results to keep in the LRU cache

name: ATR_MIN_RATIO
location: hardcoded in score_setup() ATR gate: if _atr_ratio < 0.0005
description: [V9-8] Minimum ATR/price ratio below which the market is deemed to have insufficient volatility. If ATR/price < 0.05%, score is penalized -1 point (ATR_TOO_LOW tag added to confs).

name: RANGE_30M_ATR_THRESHOLD
description: ATR ratio threshold for 30m range detection. If current ATR < 30% of the rolling average ATR, market is classified as 'in range' (informational, non-blocking).

name: BOS_DISPLACEMENT_MIN_BODY_MULT
description: ATR multiplier for minimum candle body size to confirm a valid BOS (Break of Structure) displacement candle

name: BOS_CLOSE_LOOKBACK
description: Number of recent candles checked for a close above/below the last pivot to confirm a valid BOS by close price

name: LIQUIDITY_SWEEP_CONFIRM_PCT
description: [V9-7] Percentage margin (0.3%) above/below the swept level that the close must recover to confirm a valid Liquidity Sweep. Prevents false positives from wick grazes.

name: LIQUIDITY_SWEEP_RECENT_TAIL
description: Number of recent candles forming the 'recent tail' window checked for wicks that sweep historical extremes

name: OB_QUALITY_INTACT
description: Quality score assigned to an intact Order Block (price has never revisited the zone since its formation)

name: OB_QUALITY_TESTED
location: hardcoded in _has_ob_or_fvg_alignment(): quality = 0.65 for tested status
description: Quality score assigned to a tested Order Block (price touched but did not close through the zone)

name: OB_FVG_QUALITY_FVG
description: Quality score assigned when the price is in a Fair Value Gap (FVG) zone rather than an OB

name: OB_FVG_DOUBLE_CONFIRM_BONUS
location: hardcoded in _has_ob_or_fvg_alignment(): quality = min(1.0, quality * 1.2) when FVG nested inside OB
description: Quality multiplier applied when a FVG is contained within the current OB (double confirmation). Capped at 1.0.

name: SL_ATR_BUFFER_MULT
location: hardcoded in compute_atr_levels(): sl = swing - 0.35 * atr_val
description: ATR buffer multiplier added beyond the swing high/low when computing SL in the legacy compute_atr_levels() function

name: SL_SWING_LOOKBACK
description: Lookback window (candles) for finding the swing high/low used to anchor the SL in compute_atr_levels()

name: DEFAULT_TP_RATIOS
description: Default Risk:Reward ratios for TP1/TP2/TP3 in the adaptive SL/TP engine. Calibrated on BTC/ETH/SOL backtests.

name: DEFAULT_ATR_MULT
description: Default ATR multiplier for SL distance in compute_adaptive_levels(). SL = entry +/- atr_mult x ATR_clamped.

name: FEE_BPS
description: Default trading fee in basis points included in SL/TP computation (Binance maker/taker). 4 bps = 0.04%.

name: ATR_CLAMP_LOW_PCT
description: Lower percentile for ATR clamping. ATR is clipped to [p20, p80] of rolling 30-period history to prevent extreme outliers from distorting SL/TP.

name: ATR_CLAMP_HIGH_PCT
description: Upper percentile for ATR clamping in compute_adaptive_levels()

name: ATR_CLAMP_ROLLING_WINDOW
description: Rolling window size for computing the ATR mean used in percentile clamping

name: BACKTEST_MAX_HOLD_BARS
description: Maximum number of candles a simulated trade can remain open before being force-closed at market price in the backtest engine

name: BACKTEST_COOLDOWN_BARS
description: Number of candles to wait after closing a trade before entering the next one in the backtest (prevents immediate re-entry)

name: BACKTEST_EMA_WARMUP
description: Number of initial candles skipped in the backtest to allow the EMA200 to warm up properly

name: OPT_COMBINED_SCORE_SHARPE_W
description: Weight of the Sharpe ratio in the 'combined' optimization score formula

name: OPT_COMBINED_SCORE_EXPECTANCY_W
description: Weight of the expectancy in the 'combined' optimization score formula

name: OPT_COMBINED_SCORE_MAXDD_W
description: Weight of the max drawdown term in the 'combined' optimization score formula

name: DELTA_VOL_FRESHNESS_SEC
description: Maximum age in seconds for delta volume data to be considered fresh and eligible to contribute to the DELTA_VOL scoring criterion

name: SIGNAL_HISTORY_MAX
description: Maximum number of signal history entries retained per symbol in memory and on disk

name: SCORE_MIN_FOR_HISTORY
location: hardcoded in scan_loop(): if score >= 4 and not _below_min
description: Minimum score to add a signal to the adaptive learning history. Lower than SCORE_MIN_REQUIRED to capture borderline setups for ML training.

name: UVICORN_PORT
description: TCP port the FastAPI/uvicorn server listens on

name: UVICORN_HOST
description: Host/interface the uvicorn server binds to. 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces.

name: GZIP_MIDDLEWARE_MIN_SIZE
description: Minimum HTTP response body size in bytes before GZip compression is applied to REST API responses

name: ADX_LENGTH
description: Period length for the ADX indicator used in regime detection (TREND vs RANGE classification). Standard ADX14.

name: EMA200_SPAN
description: EMA span used for the directional bias criterion on H4 and 1D timeframes. Institutional standard EMA200.

name: EMA20_SPAN
location: hardcoded in score_setup() momentum check: ta.ema(df30['close'], length=20)
description: EMA span used for the 30-second momentum confirmation check (MOM+EMA20 fallback pattern)

name: SUPERTREND_LENGTH
location: hardcoded in compute_supertrend(): ta.supertrend(..., length=10, multiplier=3.0)
description: ATR period length for the Supertrend indicator displayed on the dashboard

name: SUPERTREND_MULTIPLIER
location: hardcoded in compute_supertrend(): ta.supertrend(..., length=10, multiplier=3.0)
description: ATR multiplier for the Supertrend indicator band calculation

name: VOLUME_POC_BINS
location: hardcoded default in compute_volume_poc(): bins: int = 24
description: Number of price bins for the Volume Profile Point of Control (POC) calculation

name: VOLUME_POC_LOOKBACK
location: hardcoded default in compute_volume_poc(): lookback: int = 120
description: Lookback window (candles) for the Volume Profile POC calculation

name: TRIX_LEN_RANGE
description: Search space for TRIX period length in STRICT random calibration (inclusive range 5-51)

name: TRIX_SIGNAL_LEN_RANGE
description: Search space for TRIX signal line period in STRICT random calibration (inclusive range 5-51)

name: TRIX_TREND_MA_CHOICES
description: Discrete set of trend MA period values sampled during STRICT TRIX random search

name: ROBUST_SCORE_VAR_PENALTY
description: Penalty coefficient on standard deviation of sub-period Sharpe values in the robustness score. Higher = penalizes unstable configurations more.

name: ROBUST_SCORE_PASS_BONUS
description: Bonus coefficient on the ratio of sub-periods passing the Sharpe floor in the robustness score

name: RELAXED_FLOOR_DELTA
description: Amount subtracted from STRICT_SHARPE_FLOOR to compute the fallback relaxed mode floor when no strictly robust configs are found

name: WS_HEARTBEAT_SEC
description: WebSocket heartbeat interval in seconds for the Binance aggTrade stream connection

name: WS_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
description: Connection timeout in seconds for the Binance WebSocket stream

name: WS_GAP_FILL_MAX_SEC
description: Maximum tick gap in seconds that will be filled with flat (carry-forward) bars. Gaps larger than this are not filled.

name: REST_RETRY_COUNT
location: hardcoded in fetch_klines_history(): for attempt in range(3)
description: Number of retry attempts per page when fetching historical klines

name: REST_RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF_BASE
location: hardcoded in fetch_klines_history(): asyncio.sleep(2 ** attempt) on HTTP 429
description: Base for exponential backoff (seconds) on HTTP 429 rate limit responses. Sleep = base^attempt.

name: DNS_CACHE_TTL
description: DNS cache TTL in seconds for the aiohttp TCP connector

name: STRONG_CANDLE_BODY_RATIO
description: Minimum ratio of candle body to total candle range for classification as a strong directional candle in rejection detection

name: PIN_BAR_WICK_RATIO
description: Minimum wick-to-body ratio for a candle to qualify as a pin bar (hammer or shooting star) in rejection detection

name: DOJI_BODY_RATIO
description: Maximum body-to-range ratio for a candle to be classified as a Doji pattern

name: MARUBOZU_BODY_RATIO
description: Minimum body-to-range ratio for a candle to be classified as a Marubozu (near-complete single-direction candle)

name: OB_LOOKBACK_DEFAULT
location: hardcoded default in detect_ob(): n: int = 60
description: Default lookback window (candles) for Order Block detection in detect_ob()

name: OB_MAX_RETURNED
location: hardcoded in detect_ob(): if len(obs) >= 5: break
description: Maximum number of Order Blocks returned per detect_ob() call

name: FVG_LOOKBACK_DEFAULT
location: hardcoded default in detect_fvg(): n: int = 200
description: Default lookback window (candles) for Fair Value Gap detection in detect_fvg()

name: MOM_STRONG_BODY_RATIO
location: hardcoded in score_setup() momentum check: abs(last_c - last_o) > 0.55 * rng
description: Minimum body-to-range ratio for a 30-second candle to qualify as strong momentum confirmation (MOM+EMA20 pattern fallback)

name: OB_STATUS_LOOKBACK_AFTER
description: Number of candles after an Order Block formation that are examined when determining its intact/tested/broken status

name: FIB_TOLERANCE_MAX_SWING_PCT
description: Maximum Fibonacci tolerance expressed as a fraction of the total swing range (caps the dynamic tolerance to prevent excessively wide entry zones)

name: FIB_TOLERANCE_ZONE_FRACTION
description: Fraction of the [FIB_LEVEL_LOW, FIB_LEVEL_HIGH] zone width used as the final Fibonacci proximity tolerance

name: LOG_LEVEL
description: Python logging level for the application. DEBUG adds verbose per-symbol scan logs.

name: WS_BASES
description: Ordered list of Binance WebSocket base URLs tried in sequence for failover on connection failure

name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MIN_CLOSED_SIGNALS
location: hardcoded in circuit_breaker_monitor(): if len(pnl_list) < 5: continue
description: Minimum number of closed (non-pending) signals needed before the circuit breaker drawdown check runs for a symbol

name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_LOOKBACK_SIGNALS
description: Number of most recent signals used when computing the live drawdown for the circuit breaker comparison

name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_STARTUP_DELAY
description: Startup delay in seconds before the circuit breaker monitor starts checking drawdowns (5 minutes after application start)
